summaries.summary: India maintained their series lead against New Zealand after their latest ODI match was abandoned due to rain, ending New Zealand's winning streak.

Apple released updates for iOS and macOS, addressing various security issues. Additionally, Otter AI introduced capabilities to follow conversations in over 30 languages, while improvements to the Nintendo Switch and new music apps signify ongoing advancements in the tech sector.

Sonia Gandhi's decision to decline the Prime Minister position in 2004 is revisited in a new memoir, highlighting her political choices. Furthermore, California voters rejected a proposed billionaire tax amid intense lobbying from tech leaders.
Three workers tragically died at Tata's iPhone parts factory in Tamil Nadu during a safety incident. In related corporate activities, Anthropic is reportedly moving forward with its IPO plans.

The highly anticipated remake of 'The Ocarina of Time' has received critical acclaim, setting Metacritic records and capturing the nostalgia of '90s gamers. 'GTA 6' presales are also exceeding expectations ahead of its launch.

Concerns over air quality in Delhi persist, with reports highlighting worsening pollution levels during festive seasons, prompting policymakers and residents to seek clearer information regarding its impacts.
Allegations of espionage and personal scandals involving Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang have surfaced, leading to investigations and creating a media stir around his potential ties to known spies.
